sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Second Amendment Ordinance 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1989
ORDINANCE XIV OF
1989
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1989
An Ordinance
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 7976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd December, 1980]
No.F.2(2)/89-Pub, dated 2-12-1989.--The
following Ordinance, made by the President on 2nd December, 1989, is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Representation of the
People (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall he deemed to have taken effect on the twenty-first day of
September, 1989.

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Second Amendment Ordinance 1989
sections.description:
Amendment of section 50, Act, LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1989
ORDINANCE XIV OF
1989
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1989
An Ordinance
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 7976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd December, 1980]
No.F.2(2)/89-Pub, dated 2-12-1989.--The
following Ordinance, made by the President on 2nd December, 1989, is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 50,
Act, LXXXV of 1976.--In the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV
of 1976), in section 50, in subsection (1) for the full stop at the end a colon
shall be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added,
namely:--
"Provided
that in respect of an election held in the year 1988 or 1989, such return may
be submitted within such further time its the Federal Government may, by
notification in the Official Gazette, specify."
